subject: POC plan & final readout scheduling NovaCare
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novacare.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-10T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + next steps from today's discovery call

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary from call:
- NovaCare’s priority: reduce inference cost for clinical-document summarization while keeping 95%+ extractive fidelity.
- Volume: ~500k docs/month initially; target latency 300–600ms per request for interactive workflows.
- Security: must run in VPC with KMS for keys; SOC 2 + audit logs required.

Proposed POC scope (high level):
1) 2-week trial using 2 customer-facing models in Redwood Dedicated (quantized + fp16 variants)
2) Success criteria: production latency within 300–600ms p50/p95; cost/unit reduction >= 30% vs current baseline; no PII leakage in audit samples
3) Evaluation plan: we’ll provide an evaluation harness, you’ll run 1k representative docs and share scoring metrics; we’ll run side-by-side throughput tests
4) Timeline: kickoff next Monday (7/12), test run 7/12–7/23, readout week of 7/26
5) Ownership: Marissa (sales/POC coordination), Marcus (engineer — runtime tuning), Rishi (solutions/contract questions)

Attachments: I’m attaching the POC plan (NovaCare_POC_Plan_v1.pdf) with more detail on test cases and security checklist.

Next steps:
- Alex: confirm kickoff date and that the sample dataset will be available by 7/12
- Priya (copying): confirm who from your side will do the exec readout and decision (go/no-go) the week of 7/26

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick follow-up if anything needs clarifying.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novacare.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@novacare.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@consults.io>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today's discovery call

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Looks good to me. A few clarifications:

1) We can provide a de-identified 1k doc sample by EOD 7/12.
2) For success criteria: can we add an availability requirement (SLO) for the trial window? If the service drops below 99.5% during test runs, we need to flag it.
3) Exec readout: Priya and I will be present; we’ll invite our CTO (TBD) if engineering-level details are needed.

One ask: can you include a brief column in the POC plan that maps each test case to the metric you’ll report (latency, p95/p99, fidelity score, cost delta)? That will help us sign off faster.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Johnson
Director of AI Products | NovaCare Health
alex.johnson@novacare.com | (617) 555-4422

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novacare.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-12T08:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today's discovery call

Alex — great, thanks for confirming the sample delivery. I updated the POC plan to include a metrics mapping column and attached v1 (NovaCare_POC_Plan_v1.pdf). Key updates:

- Metrics mapping table (per test case): latency p50/p95/p99, throughput, fidelity (ROUGE + human spot check), cost per 1k tokens.
- Trial SLOs added: availability target 99.5% during load tests; we’ll surface any degradations in the readout.
- Security checklist includes KMS + audit log export format we’ll provide.

Kickoff: Let’s tentatively schedule a 30-min kickoff on 7/12 at 10:00am PT to walk through the plan and confirm owners. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Marissa

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-13T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: POC readiness + support ask for NovaCare

Marissa/Rishi —

Quick internal note after reviewing the POC plan: I’ll need the following by kickoff (7/12 was pushed -> actual kickoff 7/13 after scheduling):
- De-identified sample dataset in S3 (manifest + readme) with access role (we prefer temporary role)
- Confirmation of expected concurrency and tokenization assumptions (avg doc length, expected request rate)
- Any compliance requirements that will block remote logging (if they require on-prem logging, we need to scope)

I’ll allocate 2 engineers for tuning during the test window and can run two quantization profiles. We should propose a short canary (first 24 hours) before full-scale run.

Also — Rishi, can you confirm who owns the SOW redlines? We should have legal ready to push a minimal SOW before the readout if they go GC.

Thanks,
Marcus

- Legal has provided an initial SOW redline. I’m attaching the summary (SOW_redlines.docx). I’ll own pushing a minimal SOW for signature if NovaCare signals go at the readout.
- For exec readout: Priya, can you confirm whether this will be a go/no-go decision that requires a PO or just an internal exec sign-off? That affects how fast Legal needs to be looped.

Alex/Priya — thanks for the fast turnaround this week. Based on the trial results and availability, proposed nexts steps: 

1) Final readout: propose Tuesday 7/27 at 9:00am PT (30–45 mins) — agenda: summary of metrics, live demo of production latency, cost comparison, recommended config + proposed commercial terms. Please confirm if that slot works for your execs.
2) Decision path: if NovaCare approves, Redwood will send a minimal SOW + purchase order template same day (DocuSign link will be provided). Legal has redlines ready to accept commercial terms; we’ll need a signed SOW + PO to start Dedicated provisioning.
3) Pre-read packet: I’ve uploaded the readout deck and runbook to Drive (link above).
4) Attachments: POC plan v1 and SOW redline summary attached.

Please reply with confirmation of the readout slot and who will be the expected approver for the PO. If you prefer Monday 7/26 in the morning instead, we can shift.

Thanks all — looking forward to the readout.

Best,
